title: Reconstruct GPT-3
summary: Connect causal language modeling to in-context learning, then implement masked self-attention and token cross-entropy.

parts.title: One objective at scale
parts.prompt: What training target lets GPT-3 learn many tasks without separate supervised heads?
parts.answer: Autoregressive next-token prediction trains a general conditional sequence model. Natural-language task descriptions and examples can then condition behavior through the same token interface.
hints: Every task must be represented as text.
The model always predicts the next token.

parts.title: In-context learning
parts.prompt: How is few-shot prompting different from gradient-based fine-tuning?
parts.answer: Few-shot examples change only the input context. Model weights remain fixed; attention conditions predictions on patterns demonstrated in the prompt.
hints: Examples disappear when the context is cleared.

parts.title: Causal information flow
parts.prompt: Why must every training position be prevented from attending to later tokens?
parts.answer: The target future tokens are present in the training sequence. A causal mask prevents leakage and makes each training prediction match the information available during generation.
hints: Teacher forcing exposes the whole sequence.

parts.title: Implement causal self-attention
parts.prompt: Project X into Q, K, and V, apply a lower-triangular mask, and return attended values.

parts.title: Implement token cross-entropy
parts.prompt: Compute numerically stable softmax cross-entropy for one target class.
